summary: Prospect Capital Corporation filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, reporting the closing of a registered direct offering of $300 million aggregate principal amount of 8.95% senior unsecured notes due October 31, 2031, issued under its existing base indenture as supplemented that day, with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee. Interest pays semi-annually beginning April 30, 2027; the notes are redeemable at par plus make-whole premium before April 30, 2029 and at scheduled prices thereafter. A change-of-control repurchase right applies at 100% plus accrued interest. Watch for leverage and portfolio-yield implications.
